Canadian maple syrup
Description
• It is a sweet liquid poured over pancakes, etc.
• The production of sap needs a climate where night and day temperatures are very .
History
• Folk stories claim that maple syrup was first used to cook .
• Sap collection in spring developed into a First Nations .
• The sap was collected in buckets.
• The sap was concentrated into syrup by:
  ◦ using hot stones to produce .
  ◦ leaving it outside at night and then removing the layer of on top.
Uses
• First Nations people drank the fresh sap to give them energy.
• European settlers put the syrup in various types of .
• They also used it for drinks and for candy.
• Its use for making sugar declined after 1880, when the on Caribbean sugar was removed.
Threats
• Natural:
  ◦ Harvests may be affected by storms and destructive .
  ◦ Climate change may also affect sap production.
• Social:
  ◦ Maple syrup is expensive and faces considerable .
  ◦ The obesity issue is affecting sales.
Reasons for optimism
• Maple syrup is an important export.
• It is quite compared with other sweeteners.
• Its taste is the main reason for its popularity.

analyses.content: 录音提到晚上气温需要降到零度以下，白天则急剧上升，总结说这在24小时内是非常“different”（不同的）。
你可能听到句首的“special”就急着填上，但题目具体问的是白天和夜晚的温度怎么样，而不是气候条件怎么样。

In order for enough sap to be produced, very special climate conditions are needed. In spring, the temperatures need to drop to well below zero at night, but then they need to rise sharply during the day, so they're hugely different over a twenty-four-hour period.
录音讲到早期民间故事里，酋长的妻子用这种树液来“boil meat”（煮肉），boil完美同义替换了题目中的cook。
你可能会被前面酋长扔斧头砍树的冗长故事绕晕，一定要耐心往后听，抓住动作词“boil/cook”后面的核心宾语。

Early folk stories say it was first discovered by a chief who threw his tomahawk, which is similar to an ax, into the trunk of a tree. Clear sap started to run from the cut. His wife used this sap to boil meat, and the heat turned it into a sweet syrup, which they found delicious.
录音明确说到收集树液成为他们（第一民族）中的一种“tradition”，became完美同义替换了题目的developed into。
你可能会在听到“First Nations”时就开始走神去寻找答案词，但答案其实紧接着出现在下一句，要注意代词“them”对第一民族的指代。
Whether or not that story is true, we do know that the maple tree was very important to First Nations peoples for hundreds of years. Collecting the sap each spring became a tradition among them.
录音讲到第一种方法是把烧热的石头放进桶里来“create steam”（产生蒸汽），create对应题目中的produce。
这道题线索很直白，但你可能会因为只顾着听并理解“hot stones”的动作，而漏掉紧跟在句末的答案词“steam”。
They had two ways of doing this. One way was to drop hot stones from a fire into the buckets to create steam.
录音提到把树液放在室外过夜，顶部会形成厚厚的“layer of ice”（冰层），并且会被“discarded”（丢弃，同义替换removing），所以填ice。
你可能听到“freezing temperatures”就想填temperature，但题目问的是顶部的“layer of”什么，注意捕捉具象物质名词。

Another method that they used to concentrate the syrup was to leave the sap outside overnight, exposed to freezing temperatures. This would mean that a thick layer of ice would form on top, which could be discarded, leaving the sugary sap below.
录音说欧洲定居者将糖浆混入“medicine of different kinds”（不同种类的药物）中，different kinds替换了题目的various types。
你可能会被上一句的宏观概括“expanded its uses”干扰，没听到后面“For example”举例中具体使用的载体“medicine”。
European settlers who arrived in Canada began to learn about the syrup from First Nations peoples and further expanded its uses. For example, they incorporated it into medicine of different kinds.
录音提到在1880年之后，政府决定停止对加勒比糖征收“tax”（税），stop charging对应了题目里的removed。
你可能会被后面的“much cheaper”或“cost-effective”分心，但题目明确问的是加勒比糖上的什么东西被“removed”了，必须听准动词短语“stop charging”后的宾语。

However, after eighteen eighty, the Canadian government decided to stop charging tax on Caribbean sugar, and this made it much cheaper. That meant it was no longer cost-effective to produce maple sugar.
录音提到收成容易受到重大风暴或入侵“insects”（昆虫）的影响，并且这会破坏一切（对应destructive），所以填insects。
你可能会漏听并列连词“or”后面的内容，或者把形容词“invasive”当成答案填上去，要注意题目修饰语“destructive”后需要填名词。

However, serious threats remain. Like any agricultural product, the harvest is subject to such things as major storms or the arrival of invasive insects, both of which have happened, and these could destroy everything.
录音在说到枫糖浆很贵之后，引出如今有来自廉价品牌的“competition”（竞争），a lot of替换了considerable。
你可能会在听到第一句的“expensive”对应上题目后就觉得信息结束了，从而错过了紧随其后由“of equal concern”（同等担忧）引出的真实答案词。

Producing maple syrup is a very labor-intensive process, making it an expensive purchase. And of equal concern is the fact that nowadays there's a lot of competition from cheaper, artificially flavored brands.
录音总结说，当你把它和糖或玉米糖浆（对应other sweeteners）比较时，它仍然是相对“healthy”（健康的）。
你可能听到前面含有“proteins, minerals, and antioxidants”就急着抓个词填，但一定要等到“compare it with”这个比较级信号词出现，才能锁定最终答案。
It's certainly high in calories, but it also contains proteins, minerals, and antioxidants. As such, it is still relatively healthy when you compare it with sugar or corn syrup.
